classification.rationale: Under Section XI note 14 the garments of this costume are classified separately, so the first-named article, the coat, is classified. The coat is well made of non-fraying polyester double knit with a finished collar, lapels, turned-back cuffs and a multi-piece back, so it is wearing apparel rather than a festive article. Its tailored features point to a men's knit suit-type jacket of synthetic fibers, 6103.33.20.00. If the tailoring criteria are not met, CBP's practice for costume coats (N003904, in force) would place it in 6114.30.30.60.
